biotools.summary: Omics Playground is a user-friendly, centralized bioinformatics software designed for RNA-Seq and proteomics data analysis, offering interactive visualization and data sharing capabilities. It addresses batch effect correction using the NPmatch method, freely available on GitHub and within the software.
